models_evaluated: OCR-LLM prescription review system (deep learning OCR with local LLM)

links.outcome: System accuracy, sensitivity, specificity versus pharmacist review on local retrospective prescriptions
links.effect: 144 TP, 16 FP, 334 TN, 6 FN; accuracy 95.6%, sensitivity 96.0%, specificity 95.4%, PPV 90.0%, NPV 98.2%, F1 0.929, kappa 0.897.
links.quote: In the retrospective validation, compared with pharmacists' manual review, the system identified 144 true positives, 16 false positives, 334 true negatives, and 6 false negatives.

unlisted_practices: OCR plus local LLM structuring of prescription images with rule-base checks and pharmacist manual review triggers

screen.reason: Retrospective validation of a newly developed OCR-LLM pipeline paired with rule-based validation for reviewing inpatient narcotic/psychotropic prescriptions, without comparing deployment practices or guardrail configurations.
